crossRefs.note: Now when Mordecai found out all that was done, Mordecai tore his clothes, and put on sackcloth with ashes, and went out…
“Go, gather together all the Jews who are present in Susa, and fast for me, and neither eat nor drink three days, night…
For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the…
This was done on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of that month they rested and made it…
For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.
Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.
The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.
You will have a song, as in the night when a holy feast is kept, and gladness of heart, as when one goes with a flute…
Yahweh will cause his glorious voice to be heard, and will show the descent of his arm, with the indignation of his…
Then Yahweh’s ransomed ones will return, and come with singing to Zion; and everlasting joy will be on their heads.…
